title: internal NetServer of ClusterEventBus closes too early causing ConnectionHolder failures
body:
### Version

VertX 4.2.6

### Context

[ClusterEventBus uses NetServer#listen](https://github.com/eclipse-vertx/vert.x/blob/master/src/main/java/io/vertx/core/eventbus/impl/clustered/ClusteredEventBus.java#L90) internally but this adds a 
[closehook on context](https://github.com/eclipse-vertx/vert.x/blob/master/src/main/java/io/vertx/core/net/impl/TCPServerBase.java#L185) while ClusterEventBus expects it is in control of the LifeCycle and [wants to close the server later](https://github.com/eclipse-vertx/vert.x/blob/master/src/main/java/io/vertx/core/eventbus/impl/clustered/ClusteredEventBus.java#L110).

This leads to other nodes sending / publishing clustered messages to instantly loose the connection and triggers their [close()](https://github.com/eclipse-vertx/vert.x/blob/master/src/main/java/io/vertx/core/eventbus/impl/clustered/ConnectionHolder.java#L141)

But because the [subscriptions have not yet been updated in NodeSelector](https://github.com/eclipse-vertx/vert.x/blob/master/src/main/java/io/vertx/core/spi/cluster/NodeSelector.java#L68) the producers connect again to the closed server.

causing loads of:
`i.v.c.e.i.c.ConnectionHolder - Connecting to server 41650572-fd35-42cc-8509-369021af63bd failed`

### Steps to reproduce

1. Clustered VertX instance Producer constantly send / publish "foo" to "address"
2. Clustered VertX instance Consumer consuming "address"
3. Having a **shutdown delay** in the consumer - delay for 5 seconds (we use this "trick" to remove our microservices from discovery - finish processing - then really closing vertx)
4. close Consumer instance

### Extra

OpenJDK 18 / Fedora CoreOS 35
